lines.en: Chen, I have to take care of the paperwork before noon, so can you give me a hand?
lines.pt: Chen, preciso cuidar da papelada antes do meio-dia, então você pode me dar uma mão?

lines.en: Sure, Aya. Let me take a look at it. Is the problem the dates, or did the client change something again?
lines.pt: Claro, Aya. Deixe-me dar uma olhada. O problema são as datas, ou o cliente mudou alguma coisa de novo?

lines.en: Both. I need to keep track of every change, otherwise the invoices will not match. Could you take notes?
lines.pt: Os dois. Preciso acompanhar cada mudança, senão as faturas não vão bater. Você poderia fazer anotações?

lines.en: Of course. By the way, did you have a word with our manager about the deadline? Friday seems very tight.
lines.pt: Claro. Aliás, você conversou com nossa gerente sobre o prazo? Sexta parece muito apertado.

lines.en: Yes, she said we can have a longer break next week if we finish on time. Can you keep a secret? She mentioned a bonus.
lines.pt: Sim, ela disse que podemos ter uma pausa maior na semana que vem se terminarmos a tempo. Sabe guardar segredo? Ela falou de um bônus.

lines.en: My lips are sealed. Honestly, a bonus would help. I have to give a presentation on Monday, and I am nervous.
lines.pt: Minha boca é um túmulo. Sinceramente, um bônus ajudaria. Tenho que fazer uma apresentação na segunda, e estou nervoso.

lines.en: You will be fine. Just have confidence and practice twice. I will give you feedback on Thursday afternoon if you want.
lines.pt: Você vai se sair bem. Tenha confiança e ensaie duas vezes. Dou meu retorno na quinta à tarde, se quiser.

lines.en: That would be great. I will get some water, and then I will start with the invoices right away.
lines.pt: Seria ótimo. Vou pegar água, e depois começo pelas faturas imediatamente.

lines.en: Perfect. If you find any mistake, let me know straight away. We must not send the wrong numbers again.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Se achar algum erro, avise na hora. Não podemos mandar os números errados de novo.

lines.en: Understood. After work, would you like to join the team for dinner? Everyone is meeting downtown.
lines.pt: Entendido. Depois do trabalho, quer jantar com a equipe? Todo mundo vai se encontrar no centro.

lines.en: Maybe. First, let us finish this. Thanks, Chen, you really saved my morning, and I will not forget it.
lines.pt: Talvez. Primeiro vamos terminar isto. Obrigado, Chen, você salvou minha manhã, e não vou esquecer.

facts.label: Colocações
facts.sub: take care of · take a look · have a word · give feedback · keep track of

facts.label: cuidar e olhar
facts.sub: Take combina com take care of, take a look, take notes, take a break, take a risk. Use take para ações que você assume ou realiza.

facts.label: ter e conversar
facts.sub: Have combina com have a word with, have a break, have a meeting, have lunch, have confidence. Pense em ter ou participar de algo.

pages.title: Paperwork before noon · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday morning in an office in Denver. Cal has a pile of papers on his desk. The client needs the invoices today. Eli walks in with two coffees. Noon is coming fast. They have to work as a team.

“Eli, I have to take care of the paperwork before noon, so can you give me a hand?” says Cal. “Sure, Cal. Let me take a look at it. Is the problem the dates, or did the client change something again?” says Eli. “Both. I need to keep track of every change, otherwise the invoices will not match. Could you take notes?” says Cal.
